title: The Capture Registry: longitudinal re-capture and the claims it is set to test
description: These claims commit the AI Overview Capture Registry (#3) to re-capturing fixed queries over time and specify tests of deposits' predictions against what composition layers do. They include the feedback procedure for excluded-entity captures (#740), the Term-State Registry cadence (#824), #833's generalisation and reliability tests, controlled before-and-after re-runs after re-crawl, the transcript-coverage audit (#1614) and the matched-pair test of the Margin of Flattening (#1666). Several deposits, among them the Aristotle and Theophrastus packet (#1587), The First Draft (#1594) and the analog-artifact specifications (#1407, #1409), state in advance what the registry should record. The page also holds unrelated claims, several using "capture" in other senses.
